Entry offset moves from negative circle length to zero. The outer path takes 0.3 seconds after a 0.3-second delay in both directions, with easeInOut and a separate 0.1-second opacity track. Entry restarts the explicit zero dash and opacity values and holds completion. Clear removes both targets' paint.

The path enters over 0.4 seconds after a 0.1-second delay with easeOut; opacity takes 0.1 seconds. Return takes 0.3 seconds without delay, with the default cubic easing and a 0.3-second opacity track. Entry restarts from zero and holds. Clear removes the path paint.

Every child measures its path length. Child 0 enters over 0.4 seconds with easeOut and a 0.1-second opacity track. Later children enter over 0.3 seconds after index * 0.5 seconds, with default cubic easing and a 0.3-second opacity track. Return takes 0.3 seconds without delay, with easeOut and 0.1-second opacity. preservePose captures active replay. Entry holds. Clear removes every child's paint.

The path opacity enters through [0, 1, 0.5, 1] over 0.3 seconds after a 0.2-second delay with easeOut. Path opacity returns to 1 over 0.3 seconds without delay and with default cubic easing. The first line reveals over 0.4 seconds and the second over 0.2 seconds, including opacity, with easeOut and pathOffset values 1 and -1 respectively. Lines return over 0.3 seconds with default cubic easing. Entry restarts explicit values and holds. Clear removes path and line paint.

The last path reveals its dash and opacity over 0.4 seconds with easeInOut. Return takes 0.3 seconds with default cubic easing. preservePose resumes active replay. Entry holds. Clear removes the last path's paint.

The last path reveals its dash and opacity over 0.4 seconds with easeInOut. Return takes 0.3 seconds with default cubic easing. preservePose resumes active replay. Entry holds. Clear removes the last path's paint.
The path reveals over 0.4 seconds on entry and 0.3 seconds on return, with easeOut. Opacity takes 0.1 seconds without delay. preservePose resumes active replay. Entry holds. Clear removes path paint.

The fourth path measures its length. Entry takes 0.6 seconds with easeOut, opacity [0, 1], a dash length from zero to twice the path length with a path-length gap, and an offset from zero to negative twice the path length. Return takes 0.3 seconds with default cubic easing and targets full dash, zero offset and opacity 1. Entry restarts explicit values and holds. Clear removes the path paint.

The motion path reveals over 0.3 seconds in both directions. Entry uses a 0.15-second delay and easeOut; return has no delay and uses default cubic easing. Opacity takes 0.3 seconds with default cubic easing and an entry delay of 0.1 seconds. Entry restarts explicit values and holds. Clear removes the target paint.

Even paths measure their length and current dash fraction. Replay captures that fraction when it is finite and below 1. Motion targets 0 through 3 reveal over 0.35 seconds with easeOut after delays [0.1, 0.7999999999999999, 0.44999999999999996, 1.15] seconds.
